messages:
anna: Customer escalated — 404 when calling tool 'SendEmail' after rename to 'send_email'. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/12345

anna: Error from API:
```json
{"status":404, "error":"tool_not_found", "requested_tool":"SendEmail"}
```

sandeep: Which SDK + client cache? full request body?

anna: Repro steps:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"SendEmail","args":{"to":"x@example.com","body":"hi"}}'
```

maria: We ran registry-backfill yesterday that normalized handles to lowercase; cache TTL is 600s, some clients still hold old mapping :/

sandeep: Quick mitigation: allow case-insensitive lookup for tool names + fallback to alias table; longer term require canonical tool UUID in client calls. Will push hotfix canary.

leon: Repro with SDK v2.1.3: client caches mapping for 10m and does no casefold on Windows. Local workaround: `Client.clearToolCache()` or restart process.

deploy-bot: deploy/reg-backfill completed at 2025-11-12T03:12:00Z (job id: jb-8897)

anna: Customer saw ~50% retries -> billing spike, needs asap.

sandeep: Rolling a 1-line server fix: normalize lookup + 302 alias redirect when exact match fails. Ops @ops_bot please purge edge cache for /v1/tool-mapper and /v1/cache/*

ops_bot: Purge completed: cdn-purge-id=purge-20251112-7; invalidation ~45s.

maria: Also backfilled alias rows for legacy handles, replication lag ~5m.

anna: I'll update the customer: advise to call by tool UUID or use lowercase name for now. Thanks all :raised_hands:
